rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone’s general flighty or frivolous disposition.

example.english: They are always frivolous in the way they do things, which gives people the impression of flightiness.
example.traditional: 佢做事成日嘻嘻哈哈，畀人覺得佢有輕浮嘅性格。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 si6 seng4 jat6 hei1 hei1 haa1 haa1 bei2 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 jau5 hing1 fau4 ge3 sing3 gaak3

rows.note: Use this when the flightiness specifically means being fickle, indecisive, or unable to stick with a choice.

example.english: They have been unable to decide for a year whether to buy or rent a home; their flightiness is unbelievable.
example.traditional: 買樓定租樓，佢諗咗成年都未決定，真係三心兩意。
example.jyutping: maai5 lau2 ding6 zou1 lau2 keoi5 nam2 zo2 seng4 nin4 dou1 mei6 kyut3 ding6 zan1 hai6 saam1 sam1 loeng5 ji3

rows.note: Use this when the flightiness specifically refers to frivolous, unserious, or flirtatious conduct.

example.english: They flirt with every girl at the party, and that kind of flightiness is really embarrassing.
example.traditional: 佢喺酒會度對住每個女仔講曖昧說話，呢種輕佻嘅作風真係令人尷尬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 zau2 wui2 dou6 deoi3 zyu6 mui5 go3 neoi5 zai2 gong2 oi3 mui6 syut3 waa6 ne1 zung2 hing1 tiu1 ge3 zok3 fung1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 gaam1 gaai3
